comment: The statement that mediation is realised “at the endpoints of an exchange over a neutral transport” conflicts with the immediately preceding acknowledgement that mediation may occur through a central bus, distributed access points, gateways, or multiple mechanisms.

anchor.note: p.73 l.Lines 786-788 read as the printed page; section 3.6.1 agrees

public.text: The statement that mediation is realised “at the endpoints of an exchange over a neutral transport” conflicts with the immediately preceding acknowledgement that mediation may occur through a central bus, distributed access points, gateways, or multiple mechanisms.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with something like: “Mediation may be realised at endpoints, gateways, shared services, access points, or a combination of these, over transport arrangements selected for the national context.”
